en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, by a chain of his, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘it is disliked if one were to recite ‘Say He<sup>azwj</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is One’ (Chapter 112) in one breath’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya through the chain of his narrators has narrated who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
it is not desirable to recite all of Chapter 112 in one breath.”
